message.reasoning: We need to answer from policy excerpts. The question: "Can I schedule a recurring export of ticket data to land in cloud storage automatically each week instead of downloading it by hand?" The policy says: Recurring exports are configured from Settings → Data → Scheduled exports. Connect a cloud storage destination; Meridian supports major providers via OAuth. Save the schedule. Each run lands as a new file. So answer yes, you can schedule recurring export to cloud storage. Provide steps: go to Settings > Data > Scheduled exports, choose data, recurrence weekly, connect cloud storage, save. Also mention that scheduled exports are not subject to 10k row cap. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Yes – you can set up a weekly export that lands directly in your cloud storage.
